name: A19 one-formula candidate T37 (MOGF0IES, w = 0.1): paper rule + the expected halo given a galaxy's starlight and its sample's selection for gas-poor galaxies above M_t + halo floor; no contraction; baryons of spheroids with a measured dispersion carry the observed IMF trend
frozen_at: 2026-11-07 03:55 PST, session SA73 overnight, after T37 (held out, PROTOCOL_T37) and T38 (unfitted checks, PROTOCOL_T38)
halo_formula: M_ref = Mp/fb + 10^A (M*/1e10 Msun)^B (Re/3 kpc)^C + q M_E(M*, z | S), q = (M*/Mp)^50 / (1 + (M_t/M*)^4); M_halo = (M_ref^8 + (1e8 Msun)^8)^(1/8); M_E = posterior mean of M200c on a grid in log10 M200c from 9.0 to 16.5 (step 0.005) with weight dn/dlnM (Tinker et al. 2008, colossus, H0 67.1, Om 0.3175, Ob 0.049, sigma8 0.8344, ns 0.9624) x exp(-0.5 [(log10 M* - log10 M*_Moster(M200c, z))/0.180]^2) x S(M200c) (Moster, Naab and White 2013 with redshift evolution; 0.180 = sqrt(0.15^2 + 0.10^2) dex); below M* = 10^9.5 Msun M_E is the mean inversion; NFW with dark mass (1-fb) M_halo inside r200 at the halo redshift, Dutton and Maccio (2014) concentration, satellites x (1 - 0.54 log10(D/r200,host)) (Moline et al. 2017); no contraction; fb = 0.049/0.3175, h = 0.671; lensing M_p as a point mass

selection_S.CLASH clusters: M200c > 5e14 Msun (Postman et al. 2012: X-ray selected, kT > 5 keV)
selection_S.MaNGA BCGs: M200c > 1e14 Msun (the MaNGA BCG program's aim)
selection_S.every other sample (disks, dwarfs, early: none (chosen by their light, not their halos)

baryons: as T26: stellar g_bar of spheroids with a measured velocity dispersion x alpha_IMF = 10^(0.38 log10(sigma_e/200 km/s) - 0.06 + 0.215) (Posacki et al. 2015; Chabrier scale via Madau and Dickinson 2014), for the 50 MaNGA BCGs and the 16 SPARC early types
coefficient_count: 4 (A, B, C set on disks alone; log10 M_t from the joint fit); the selection thresholds are taken from the surveys, not fitted

unfitted_checks_T38.bins_within_mark: 12 of 14 (red 10^11.48 +0.23 against 0.20; blue 10^10.56 +0.34, the rule's known miss)

dwarf_upper_limits_exceeded: 3 of 10 (unchanged: the switch is zero for dwarfs)
caveats: adaptive: the relation was found on these data (T31 to T34, all data) before it was built in; T37 tests only that it survives the refit of M_t held out
MaNGA depends on the program's stated threshold: at 10^13.8 suns it scores 0.123 to 0.125 (T34)
CLASH's selection is stated in temperature (kT > 5 keV); 5e14 suns M200c is its mass equivalent; the gain holds from 3e14 to 7e14 (T34)
lensing remains the weakest score (69.5 against 49.1 for an 18-coefficient mixture); the KiDS early/late split stays about a third of the measured one
the early types' inner points are ATLAS3D JAM values, which Posacki et al. used
status: retrospective and adaptive; frozen here for a blind test on new systems
